ai-review-arm.finding_class: authorization-arm-rollout-not-ready: armed adopters with an incomplete generated adopter caller set
ai-review-arm.reason: Provisioning (#1803) finished on 2026-10-15: every armed repository's ai-review-app environment has a main-only deployment branch policy and holds AI_REVIEW_APP_PRIVATE_KEY. What remains is consumer drift tracked in #1810. Re-recorded 2026-11-03 from a live read-only audit run, after the main-protection suspension image (#2002, ADR 0254) let the audit reach this check again. Its items= digest equals an independent per-repository enumeration (ADR 0189 2026-10-18 amendment): for each of the 32 repositories carrying the live arm selector property, the default-branch git tree was listed and checked for every completeness caller in the rollout contract. 35 generated adopter callers are missing across 23 armed repositories: 12 kept from the 20 recorded on 2026-10-18 (9 ai-review-label-rearm.yml, 3 ai-promotion-retry.yml); 8 ai-review-label-rearm.yml resolved since then; 23 ai-review-lifecycle-rearm.yml new, because #1993 added that caller to the completeness set (#1982), and consumers regenerate it under #1982. No armed repository lacks its admission caller. Actions-paused repositories (27 of the 32, which ruleset 20722935 excludes from enforcement) are still counted, so the finding stays conservative (ADR 0254). A shrinking item set now adjudicates as improved (ADR 0189 2026-10-21 amendment); re-record on any other change, and remove once the audit reports no finding.

ai-review-arm.finding: authorization-arm-rollout-not-ready: main-protection (18098028) matches the reviewed suspended image (#1933)
ai-review-arm.reason: main-protection (18098028) is disabled under the owner hold tracked in #1933, which names no review date. The audit recognizes that state as the derived suspended image (the split postimage with only enforcement: disabled; ADR 0254, ARB RUN-D, #1992) and reports it as this one constant finding, so every later check still runs. Expires 30 days after recording (ARB RUN-D D-2); extending it is a new reviewed diff. Remove this entry, and the test binding it to the audit's text, once #1933 restores enforcement: the finding then stops reproducing and the scheduled run reports it stale.
